title: Emergency Triage Acuity Queue & Charge-Nurse Escalation Gate
required_invariants: Acuity score must lie in [1, 5] and wait_minutes must be non-negative; invalid values raise ValueError.
Acuity 1 or 2 patients must always route to immediate_resuscitation regardless of bed capacity.
Acuity 3 patients waiting > 30 minutes must escalate to charge_nurse_review.
Bed assignment when available_beds == 0 must never return direct_bed_assign for acuity >= 3.
